class.name: DebugCamera
class.brief_description: A free-flying camera for looking at the game from anywhere, on this machine only.
class.description: The [GameplayDebuggerHUD] creates and removes it ([code]gfgd_debug_free_camera[/code], Tab by default, or [code]gd.freecam[/code]). W A S D fly along the view, Q and E go down and up, the mouse looks around, Shift is faster, Ctrl slower, and the wheel changes [member speed]. The keys are physical, so they sit in the same place on any keyboard layout. It moves in real time, so it keeps flying with the game slowed down ([code]slomo[/code]) or paused. It ignores input while the console is open.

method.name: start_from
method.description: Places the camera at [param transform] with [param field_of_view], keeping only its yaw and pitch.

members.member: Radians per pixel of mouse movement.
Flying speed in metres per second, before Shift or Ctrl.
